verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents AI-powered features that generate insights/suggestions from request data—renaming requests, generating structured payloads, and writing pre-request/test scripts automatically—but these are narrow, workflow-automation aids rather than broader data insights (e.g., no AI analysis of response data, API behavior trends, or error diagnostics). missing for 10: evidence of AI analyzing response data/API behavior for insights, independent/hands-on validation of AI feature quality, broader scope beyond request/script generation.
